They once believed that the rules they carried would depart with the traveler.

But they had already been used, misread, and remade by the lives of this world.

They would not reclaim them in the name of correction. They left only an observer to record what those rules would change.

Should a new signal cross the threshold beyond this world, the self beyond would decide whether to answer; the observer could not judge for anyone.

The Spire did not stop for this. Those who remained continued to choose.
